title: Adding spatial lookups to RasterField interpolated the user-supplied band index from the lookup tuple straight into the PostGIS SQL template, so a non-integer band index injects SQL.

findings.explanation: The change only adds type‑checking for raster band indices before they are used in spatial operators. No SQL string construction or query execution is introduced, so there is no risk of SQL injection.

The modification introduces input validation for raster band indices but does not affect any authorization checks, object ownership verification, or protected operation gating. Therefore no authorization flaw is introduced.
